question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**foresee**" means to be aware of beforehand; to predict or expect.
 
• The passage is discussing events that could happen unexpectedly, and the choice of **"foresee" fits the idea of something happening suddenly that one did not anticipate.**
 
• The other options: "**legalise**", "**rescind**", and "**affect**" do not fit the context of predicting or anticipating an event.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *Something can happen within a second, and one may not **foresee**__ it.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Legalise (क़ानूनी मान्यता देना)**: means to make something legal or permissible by law.
 
• **Rescind (समाप्‍त करना)**: means to revoke, cancel, or repeal a law, order, or agreement.
 
• **Affect (प्रभावित करना)**: means to have an effect on; to make a difference to.
